findings.message: Identical content writes retain the previous revision, including leaving revision absent on a legacy artifact. The approved writer must increment on every content write, including record regeneration. Documenting this as a build deviation does not amend the supplied approval.
findings.expectationRef: PLAN t1 acceptance check 1; LLD writeArtifact postcondition: content writes set revision to prior revision + 1.

findings.message: The provenance writer uses 'meta-only', so feedback writes do not mint a revision. Both the implementation and its inventory classification contradict the explicitly approved content classification.
findings.expectationRef: PLAN t3 summary; LLD ARTIFACT_WRITE_INVENTORY classifies provenance/writer.ts as content.

findings.message: Readiness additionally requires isUnitSettled. Consequently, a recorded issue with a failed parent link triggers tracker loading and can become not-ready; a successful creation whose record cannot be saved also becomes not-ready. The approved behavior treats linking and recording failures as nonblocking, returns the known issue, and resolves local refs without tracker calls.
findings.expectationRef: LLD ensureDraftIssues local-record fast path; ensureUnitIssueDetailed steps 3–4; error case 'The issue is created but the record cannot be written' specifies no visible user impact.

findings.message: The team Task loop only ensures issues. It never runs a body-comment extra for each Task; the subsequent extras call posts a plan review to the Story instead. Task body comments and their per-Task completion marks are therefore missing.
findings.expectationRef: LLD autoPushTasksOnPlan postcondition: each Task's body comment runs through runUnitExtras; runUnitExtras parameters specify that a Task gets its body comment.

findings.message: findIssues caps the listing at 1,000 and rejects results reaching that ceiling instead of completing pagination. At that size the duplicate check cannot select the lowest issue even when the tracker is available.
findings.expectationRef: LLD interactionWithShared sc1: findIssues returns every matching open or closed issue with complete pagination and ascending numeric order; PLAN t11 requires listing every issue carrying the unit label.

findings.message: Correctness: after a Story or Task create commits remotely but times out, the retry adopts it by label and immediately records it as settled. This branch never links the adopted issue to its parent or records a pending link, so the child can remain permanently unlinked while readiness reports success.

Avoidable complexity: inventory validation combines an AST writer detector with separate regex-based function and argument parsing. writeKindsIn searches through the next semicolon rather than inspecting the third argument, so a 'content' literal in artifact data or a comment can satisfy the check for a meta-only call. Reuse AST traversal for function boundaries and write-kind arguments to avoid false validation.

Duplication: patchTrackerMeta independently implements the same tracker-block spread and per-unit merge as carryTracker. These two paths govern preservation of issue references during patches and replacements; changes to merge semantics can easily reach only one path. Share the merge implementation while preserving the adapter default.

Unhandled error path: buildSpec only catches reading/parsing the plan, then calls .find and t.id.toLowerCase on unchecked JSON. A malformed tasks value or missing task ID throws through ensureUnitIssueDetailed and ensureUnitIssue instead of returning their declared failure result. Validate the parsed task structure or convert construction errors into a before-create failure.
